Analytical Biography of Aurangzeb:

Following are the books recommended on frequent requests by the followers of this page to read ‘Good and impartial books’ on the History of the subcontinent in General and Aurangzeb in particular.

Following three analytical books are written by Non-Muslim historians on the life of Aurangzeb.

1. Aurangzeb: The man and the myth by Audrey Truschke. 2017, p 189 (English)

2. Aurangzeb- attitudes and Inclinations by Rekha Joshi. 1978, p 45 (English) Out of print.

3. Aurangzeb – Ek Naya Zaviya-e-Nazar by Dr. Om Prakash Prasad. 1990, p 86 (Urdu) Out of print.
